t2.thesis: RDDT goes into the print washed out (-12% in 5 days, -48% from its 52-week high, ~14x forward P/E) with expectations reset toward slower growth, which roughly offsets the risk of another 'beat but sell' reaction like July's on US DAU softness, so I hold close to the base rate.
reasons: Positioning is heavily de-risked: 5-day return -11.7%, 12-month return -38%, and the headlines are uniformly about slowdown fears (I7, I9, I17, I22).
Valuation is undemanding for 61% revenue growth and a 29% operating margin: forward P/E about 14 against P/S about 9.4 (I2).
Consistent large EPS beats and upward revisions (90-day EPS revision +5.3%), but July showed that a 30% beat still produced a -18% reaction on user metrics (I2, I4).
US DAUq is flat quarter on quarter (6% YoY). Logged-in DAUq growth is only 7% and that disclosure is being dropped from Q3 onward, a possible bear talking point (I5).
The implied move is about 13% and options skew is near neutral, so the outcome is symmetric and high-variance (I1, I2).
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue/EBITDA guidance versus the slowdown fears, plus the trajectory of US DAUq.

theses.mechanism: Q4 guide implies 50%+ growth with ad pricing intact; shorts cover after a 12% pre-print drawdown.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guide midpoint implies growth under about 45% or misses consensus.

theses.mechanism: US DAUq declines quarter on quarter and search-traffic headwinds dominate the narrative despite a beat, repeating July.
theses.wrong_if: US DAUq grows sequentially or management quantifies a stabilizing search contribution.

theses.mechanism: Reddit Max/AI ad tools and ARPU growth near 35%+ show monetization offsetting slower users.
theses.wrong_if: Ad price growth decelerates sharply from about 40% or margin guidance compresses due to rising costs.
